title: SpendSourceUnreadable payload
description: The source is no `eval.run-manifest/1`, driven run cursor or transcript a reader recognises (a transcript with no terminal record and no request), or a terminal record's `total_cost_usd` is neither a number nor `null` (`SpendSourceUnreadable`, planning/task_spend.rs `read_spend`); the refusal names the file. Nothing is written.
